reviews.text: I arrived at the clinic in a complete panic, and Dr. Sperandio immediately took charge. While my cat was dying before my eyes, he saved her life. He was also very understanding, taking my financial situation into account. After one night in the hospital, she's already doing much better. She's back home and has even started playing gently again. Thank you so much for saving one of the most precious beings in my heart.

My cats, Lily and Coco, and my daughter's cat Yushi, have been and continue to be treated at the Domvet veterinary clinic in Butte aux Cailles. The entire team is professional, available, attentive, and shows great kindness to both the animals and us! They take the necessary time, clearly explain the possible treatments, answer all our questions, reassure us, and support us with great compassion through all stages of our animals' lives, especially during the most painful moments. I am extremely grateful for their gentle and kind support during Lily's final days. Their empathy and compassion made this ordeal a little more bearable, and I thank the team again warmly. We are very fortunate to have them nearby, and I highly recommend this veterinary clinic to all animal lovers!
We regularly take our cats there, and everything always goes very well! The vets and veterinary assistants are very attentive and also very responsive if you have any questions.

My dog ​​and cat have been patients at this clinic for four years. We receive attentive and warm care. Dr. Sperandio and his team are caring, knowledgeable in their approach, and provide the necessary advice for monitoring the care and health of our four-legged companions. During my last visit on Saturday, I left feeling reassured after my dog's checkup.

I recently adopted an adult dog and have needed several medical procedures since then. The Domvet team provided excellent support and was always available and attentive, from the dog's registration in France to the final surgeries. Appointments are quick to schedule, and the staff is friendly; my dog ​​even enjoys cuddling them when I leave.
Conscientious, available and caring veterinarians. Very attentive to their little four-legged patients.

They've been taking care of my dog ​​for four years, always perfectly, even in emergencies, surgeries, follow-up appointments, etc.
My dog ​​is small (2 kg), so they completely adapt to his weight to ensure he receives the appropriate treatments.
Everything has always gone very well.
My vet has set up a dietary program for our little Shetland pony 💚 …
I do not recommend this veterinary clinic. The vet spent half the consultation time trying to convince me to buy their kibble, jelly, etc.
Excellent welcome and service

Several veterinarians share the practice, and each one of them is kind and caring towards owners and our furry friends 🐕‍🦺😻. I have a cat, "Cilka," and a dog, "Tibou," who are both patients at this clinic. They get their vaccinations and minor ailments treated 🤕, and the care they provide is thorough and attentive. Thank you for your work.
Perfect!!!! Thank you for everything!!!!!

I brought in a kitten I was looking after who had an eye ulcer, and Dr. Sperandio treated him gently, taking the time to explain everything thoroughly and provide a report for the owner. The veterinary assistant was kind and caring.

I am very satisfied with the professionalism, responsiveness, helpful advice, and clear explanations of the team, and I will definitely return for my pet!

Mr. Sperandio is a crook! He performed a castration on my dog ​​some time ago, which he claimed was essential because he had an undescended testicle. According to Mr. Sperandio, castration was absolutely necessary because the undescended testicle would cause cancer.

Therefore, worried about my dog ​​after hearing this "veterinarian's" statements, I asked him for a quote, which I never saw.
He gave me a verbal price range while I waited for the quote, which he said would be around €200. So I quickly scheduled an appointment and asked him for a quote again.

He told me he would give it to me the day I dropped my dog ​​off. But on the day of the appointment, he was in a hurry, and I didn't get a quote. I dropped my dog ​​off in the morning and received a call from him saying everything went well and asking me to pick him up around 5 pm. When I arrived at the clinic, he explained that my dog ​​was fine. I found my dog ​​completely disoriented and frightened (which can be normal after anesthesia). Apparently, the operation was complicated, and Mr. Sperandio had to call a colleague for help.
Of course, all this without him calling me beforehand to ask my opinion or warn me of any potential complications.

When it came time to pay,

he ended up asking me for just under €800... yes, yes, yes, for the castration of a male French Bulldog...
I finally understood why he hadn't provided an estimate.

But the worst part, and I want to emphasize this, is that this person has the nerve to contact you with his cell phone number when you leave him a one-star review... Avoid at all costs! There's a very good clinic in the 13th arrondissement, also on Rue des Rentiers; Dr. Rault is a gem.

Run away and don't let yourself be fooled by this kind of crook!

Just to remind you, this isn't my first dog, and certainly not my first pet. But unfortunately, it's the first time I've had to deal with this kind of shameful and despicable behavior.
You have a bad reputation that's only getting worse with each passing year. Scams seem to be working quite well, since this gentleman has had the luxury of opening another practice.
I hope your conscience is clear.

Dr. Sperandio has absolutely no empathy for animals; he only thinks about how much money he'll make. Even in an emergency, if he's not available, he asks you to make an appointment and wait. He's a real machine, seeing patients assembly-line style without taking the time to get to know the animal. At first, I thought he was afraid of getting his hands dirty, but it turns out he's just not interested in cuddling and reassuring my little Bibine. He has two offices and juggles both, so he doesn't have much time to dedicate to patients. Therefore, it's never the same vet who sees us without prior notice. They look at the file, but it's not complete, and they don't know the animal, so there's no real follow-up care.

Excellent vet.
My cat, Gimpy, agrees. Except he really doesn't like the cone he was given after the surgery.

And as for the smile: "Ginger, grumpy, with one ear missing: I've found him. This cat is the reincarnation of Van Gogh."
Dr. Sperandio and his colleagues are truly excellent veterinarians. They pinpoint their little patients' problems precisely and focus on the essentials when it comes to treatment. …

After a few years, I decided to leave a review.
The vet who treated my cat was impeccable with my pet, 10/10. However, one hour later, I called and got the other vet because my usual vet wasn't there, and …

=>Following the review below, the vet just called me, threatening to contact all his colleagues in the area so they refuse to treat my cats! Bravo for the lack of ethics, and thank you so much for the animals...it just goes to show I wasn't …

My dog ​​was seen quickly and we left with a two-week course of treatment. The treatment he received was professional and gentle, which I appreciated. The treatments were effective and my dog ​​is no longer in pain.

Excellent place. Wonderful staff. They were very kind and gentle with my cat. They also answered all my questions. Despite my limited French, the veterinarian understood me perfectly and explained everything clearly. Thank you so much, I am very grateful to this clinic ❤️
The best veterinarians I've ever met, in every respect. And I mustn't forget the reception staff, always smiling, kind, and welcoming.
